display_name: Azarias, one of the Three Youths

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 decembrie, «Sfântul Proroc Daniel și Sfinții trei tineri Anania, Azaria și Misail», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Δεκεμβρίου, «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ», with the rank word left off. The page gives this name no gloss.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s first heading for 17. децембар ст. ст., „Свети пророк Данил и три отрока: Ананије, Азарије и Мисаил.“ — the second of the three names the heading prints after the colon, bare as it prints them. THE FOLD WAS MEASURED BEFORE THE FORM WAS WRITTEN: `fk.mjs` puts the key `азарије` at NO other holder, so no READ_FOLDS key is written.

The calendar’s own name page for him is «Азария Вавилонский, отрок, мч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the epithet kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

feast.note: The same menologion day this folder’s other rows already carry, so there is no second day and none is noted. NO `dates` ARE WRITTEN FROM THIS LINE: it closes «(600 до Р.Х.)», a round figure for the prophet’s company, and this folder has no date from any source; nothing is minted from it. The calendar calls him «отрок, мч.», a youth and a martyr, which is the `type` this folder already carries. The readings this calendar links, `/Life/id583.htm`, an INDEX, and `/Life/life3136.htm`, which stands behind all three youths at once, were NOT opened; this folder’s life is already written out of its other sources. Two of the day page’s three hymn blocks are his company’s and are written here; the third is the prophet’s alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 декабря ст. ст. — «Прор. Даниила и трех отроков: Анании, Азарии и Мисаила (600 до Р.Х.).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 17 decembrie — «Sfântul Proroc Daniel și Sfinții trei tineri Anania, Azaria și Misail»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the corpus already keeps for them, and the entry is the same four: Daniel renamed Belteshazzar and the three Hebrew youths who would not worship Nebuchadnezzar's golden image. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr adds that Daniel is one of the four major prophets, that he was of the tribe of Judah and of royal descent, that he was born at Upper Bethara, that he was taken captive to Babylon as an infant with his parents, that he and the three were schooled at the imperial court by Nebuchadnezzar's provision and given great place in the state when they came of age, and that he died in deep old age most probably at Susa. **It dates him to the end of the seventh and the beginning of the sixth century before Christ**, which is recorded in `dates` only where the folder had none. It names Upper Bethara, Babylon and Susa; no coordinate is proposed, because the page itself says «πιθανότατα» of Susa. It prints an apolytikion naming all four, which is taken into each of the four folders; a kontakion naming Daniel alone, which is taken into his; a second kontakion addressed to the three in the furnace, which is taken into theirs; and an oikos and a kathisma, which are kinds the schema does not hold.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 30.12.2025 (17. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Данил и три отрока: Ананије, Азарије и Мисаил.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. The heading NAMES HIM, second of the three youths. The third calendar to keep him on this menologion day. `types` UNTOUCHED: `martyr` is held and this book’s beheading is a second witness to it. NO `dates`, for the reason given in the `daniel-the-prophet` entry: the figure of about five hundred years before Christ stands in a singular sentence about Daniel. NO `locations`, NO `related` ROW ADDED — the other two youths, Daniel and `cyril-of-alexandria` were all here. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: the royal tribe of Judah; the golden idol in the plain of Dura and the refusal to bow; the fiery furnace, the angel who cooled it, the walking unhurt and the singing of „Благословен јеси Господе отаца наших“; the king’s horror and the honours that followed; and HIS OWN ACT, which is the one thing in the entry that is his alone — when Ananias was beheaded, AZARIAS SPREAD OUT HIS OWN GARMENT AND CAUGHT HIS HEAD, and was then beheaded himself, his head being caught by Misael. The sung words are the youths’ canticle in the book’s narrative and NOTHING was put in `hymns`, which §3 forbids. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mari sunt faptele credinţei; că în mijlocul izvorului văpăii, ca într-o apă de odihnă sfinţii trei Tineri s-au bucurat şi Prorocul Daniel păstor leilor ca unor oi s-a arătat. Pentru rugăciunile lor, Hristoase Dumnezeule, miluieşte-ne pe noi.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Proroc Daniel și al Sfinților trei tineri Anania, Azaria și Misail (one hymn printed for the four together)

english.text: Great are the achievements of faith: in the midst of the fountain of flame, as in restful water, the three holy Youths rejoiced, and the prophet Daniel was shown to be a shepherd of lions as of sheep. By their prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us.

hymns.text: Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως κατορθώματα! ἐν τῇ πηγῇ τῆς φλογός, ὡς ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀναπαύσεως, οἱ ἅγιοι τρεῖς παῖδες ἠγάλλοντο· καὶ ὁ Προφήτης Δανιήλ, λεόντωv ποιμήv, ὡς προβάτων ἐδείκνυτο. Ταῖς αὐτῶν ἰκεσίαις, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος β’, printed without a model. It names the Three Youths and Daniel together, so it is the service of all four and is taken into each of the four folders, on the page of «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ».

english.text: Great are the achievements of faith! In the spring of the flame, as at the water of rest, the holy Three Youths rejoiced; and the prophet Daniel was shown to be a shepherd of lions, as though of sheep. At their entreaties, O Christ God, have mercy on us.

hymns.text: Χειρόγραφον εἰκόνα μὴ σεβασθέντες, ἀλλ᾽ ἀγράφῳ οὐσίᾳ θωρακισθέvτες, τρισμακάριοι ἐν τῷ σκάμματι, τοῦ πυρὸς ἐδοξάσθητε· ἐν μέσῳ δὲ φλογός, ἀvυποστάτου ἱστάμεvοι, Θεὸν ἐπεκαλεῖσθε· Τάχυνοv ὦ οἰκτίρμωv, καὶ σπεῦσον ὡς ἐλεήμωv, εἰς τὴv βοήθειαν ἡμῶv, ὅτι δύνασαι βουλόμενος.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. β’, Αὐτόμελον. It addresses the three thrice-blessed ones in the furnace and not Daniel, so it is taken into the three youths' folders only, on the page of «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ».

english.text: Not revering the hand-made image, but armoured with the Essence that is not drawn, O thrice-blessed ones, you were glorified in the arena of the fire; and standing in the midst of a flame that had no power over you, you called upon God: hasten, O compassionate one, and come quickly, as you are merciful, to our help, for you can do as you will.

hymns.text: Велия веры исправления:/ во источнице пламене, яко на воде упокоения,/ святии трие отроцы радовахуся,/ и пророк Даниил/ львом пастырь, яко овцам, являшеся./ Тех молитвами, Христе Боже,// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 декабря ст. ст. — «Тропарь пророка Даниила и трех отроков Анании Азарии и Мисаила», глас 2. The company’s own proper, naming the three youths and the prophet together, and written on all four folders of the line. It is the Church Slavonic of the Greek troparion «Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως κατορθώματα» this folder already carries.

english.text: Great are the achievements of faith! In the fountain of flame, as at the water of rest, the three holy youths rejoiced; and the prophet Daniel was shown to be a shepherd of lions, as though of sheep. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Рукописаннаго образа не почетше,/ но неописанным существом защитившеся, треблаженнии,/ в подвизе огня прославистеся;/ среде же пламене нестерпимаго стояще, Бога призвасте:/ ускори, о Щедрый!/ и потщися, яко милостив, в помощь нашу,/ яко можеши хотяй.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 декабря ст. ст. — «Кондак отроков», глас 6. The three youths’ own proper, addressing them as the thrice-blessed and on their three folders only; it is the Church Slavonic of the Greek kontakion «Χειρόγραφον εἰκόνα μὴ σεβασθέντες» this folder already carries.

english.text: Not honouring the image made by hands, but armoured with the Essence that cannot be described, O thrice-blessed ones, ye were glorified in the contest of the fire; and standing in the midst of the unbearable flame ye called upon God: hasten, O bountiful One, and come quickly, as Thou art merciful, to our help, for Thou canst do whatsoever Thou willest.
